entry.title: Nullcon HackIM 2023 Crypto - Curvy Decryptor
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Nullcon HackIM 2023's Curvy Decryptor admits off-curve guests. Shift EC points past the decryption filter, then recover the private key with invalid curves and CRT.

entry.title: ACSC qualifiers 2023 Crypto - SusCipher
entry.summary: CTF writeup: ACSC 2023's SusCipher gets cross-examined by Z3: 48 single-bit plaintexts give a model enough evidence to recover the three-round block cipher's key.

entry.title: Google CTF 2022 Crypto - Maybe Someday
entry.summary: Google CTF 2022 cryptography writeup maybe someday paillier cryptosystem homomorphic padding oracle

entry.title: Cyber Apocalypse HTB 2022 Crypto - Memory Acceleration
entry.summary: CTF writeup: HTB Cyber Apocalypse 2022's Memory Acceleration puts Z3 on a diet: brute-force part of a custom proof-of-work hash and model the smaller remainder.

entry.title: SDCTF 2022 Crypto - Tasty Crypto Roll
entry.summary: CTF writeup: SDCTF 2022's Tasty Crypto Roll seasons its key with a PID. Recover it, undo bit shuffling and let Z3 solve the ECB substitution constraints.

entry.title: Google CTF 2021 Crypto - Pythia
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Google CTF 2021's Pythia has commitment issues: AES-GCM key multicollisions turn a partitioning oracle into a short-password recovery tool.

entry.title: rgbCTF 2020 Crypto - N-AES
entry.summary: CTF writeup: rgbCTF 2020's N-AES has more layers than entropy: brute-force a fixed one-byte seed to undo 128 AES layers, minding Python's int-versus-bytes seed trap.

entry.title: rgbCTF 2020 Crypto - Adequate Encryption Standard
entry.summary: CTF writeup: rgbCTF 2020's Adequate Encryption Standard has a custom cipher whose key schedule gets stuck on 0 or 1. Reverse the rounds and exploit the rut.

entry.title: 0CTF/TCTF 2020 Crypto - babyring
entry.summary: CTF writeup: 0CTF/TCTF 2020's babyring makes RC4 run in circles. Reduce the ring check to XOR equations and let SageMath choose RSA inputs that close the loop.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - worst_pw_manager
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Eight Python references in a trench coat pose as an RC4 key in redpwnCTF 2020's worst-pw-manager. Decode filenames, then brute-force the repeated key byte.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - Pseudo-key
entry.summary: CTF writeup: A Vigenere key encrypts itself in redpwnCTF 2020's Pseudo-key, leaving 2,048 candidates. Self-care would have involved a different key.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - primimity
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Three RSA primes share a postcode in redpwnCTF 2020's primimity. Search near the modulus's cube root to find the factors.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - Itsy Bitsy
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Leading bits in this random XOR keystream insist on being 1. Their predictable habits expose the plaintext in redpwnCTF 2020's Itsy Bitsy.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - base646464
entry.summary: CTF writeup: redpwnCTF 2020's base646464 applies Base64 25 times. A Python decode loop respectfully declines to call that encryption.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - Alien Transmissions v2
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Even aliens have word-spacing habits. Frequency analysis recovers a combined XOR key in redpwnCTF 2020's Alien Transmissions v2; Z3 splits it in two.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - 4k-rsa
entry.summary: CTF writeup: A large RSA modulus made of smaller primes is factorization's bulk discount in redpwnCTF 2020's 4k-rsa. Recover the factors and decryption exponent.

entry.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - 12 Shades of Redpwn
entry.summary: CTF writeup: redpwnCTF 2020's 12 Shades of Redpwn makes the color wheel do arithmetic. Map hues to base-12 digits and convert the result to text.

entry.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - gboad maddy
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Gboard's alternate symbols get promoted to ciphertext in zh3r0 CTF 2020's gboad maddy. Map them to letters, apply ROT13 and infer the missing characters.

entry.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - We are related
entry.summary: CTF writeup: Chosen suffixes give RSA messages a family resemblance in zh3r0 CTF 2020's We Are Related. Franklin-Reiter recovers the shared plaintext.

entry.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - Uncipher Me
entry.summary: CTF writeup: zh3r0 CTF 2020's Uncipher Me sends us on an encoded-key scavenger hunt. The ROT47-derived key opens the Fernet token; the other keys are busywork.
